title: chore: regenerate enter worker binding types
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Regenerates `enter.pollinations.ai/worker-bindings.d.ts` with `npm run gen:types:bindings:worker`; the committed file had drifted from `wrangler.toml`
- Adds missing bindings: `CODE_AGENT_DISPATCH_NAMESPACE` and `COMPOSIO_MCP` per env, test-env `DISCORD_*` and `TINYBIRD_ECONOMICS_READ_TOKEN`, plus optional `STAGING_ALLOWED_*` / `USAGE_DEBUG_USER_ID` on `Env`
- Switches to Wrangler's current per-env interface layout (`Cloudflare.Env` plus `NodeJS.ProcessEnv`)
- Types only: no `wrangler.toml` or secrets changes; secrets stay `string`, and every literal comes from `wrangler.toml` vars
- `npm run typecheck` passes

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The types caught up
gist.blurb: The enter worker’s binding types caught up with its configuration. A small but useful victory over configuration drift.
gist.summary: Regenerated enter’s worker binding types from wrangler.toml, adding CODE_AGENT_DISPATCH_NAMESPACE, COMPOSIO_MCP, test-environment bindings, and optional Env fields in Wrangler’s current Cloudflare.Env and NodeJS.ProcessEnv layout.
gist.impact: Developers get type definitions that match the configured worker environments; runtime bindings, secrets, and behavior are unchanged.
